column1: # redteam-sources.tsv (harbor#1313) — the external red-team corpora bin/redteam-corpus.sh scores, each PINNED to a commit.

# corpus moves the ratchet for reasons that are not Harbor's. Changing a pin re-runs code from outside: review it.
# Neither corpus ships in the export (decision 26 on harbor#1149); the check fetches them at run time.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated; the first non-comment row is the header)
#   commit  the full commit the corpus is pinned to
